# Flathub repository metadata (not an application)

Source: https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
Retrieved over HTTPS: 2026-10-28. Retained verbatim, including its signing key.
SHA-256: `3371dd250e61d9e1633630073fefda153cd4426f72f4afa0c3373ae2e8fea03a`
Primary OpenPGP fingerprint: `6E5C05D979C76DAF93C081354184DD4D907A7CAE`.

This is public repository registration metadata published by Flathub, not
third-party program code. No upstream software or application license is being
replaced. The embedded key verifies repository content; the descriptor itself
is not a detached-signed release. Its initial trust is the official HTTPS
source and the pinned key, not an independently verified release signature.
Recheck this source and fingerprint before deliberately updating the pin.
The installer verifies the pinned descriptor digest before copying it and
never downloads metadata during login. It preserves Flatpak GPG verification.
